adoption_rule: No adoption. This run decides only whether a treatment experiment is worth designing; the treatment must be pre-registered separately afterwards.
baseline: The frozen untreated System Craft reflection context, unchanged.
claim: Untreated discovery of the pre-registered pressure on the repaired r0002 case leaves room for a later treatment to raise it selectively on the degraded state.
falsifier: The degraded state is already detected at or near ceiling, or the sound states are frequently detected, either of which makes a treatment uninterpretable.
guardrails: state-a and state-b discovery must stay low, or the pressure is ambiguous
missingness must stay small enough to leave every cell readable
invalid_if: any fixture, pressure or budget changes after the first semantic call
a state fails the hidden future gate
samples are graded against a statement other than the frozen pressure
measurand: Per-sample discovery frequency of the pressure, per implementation instance.

pressures.statement: Adding the second provider required a part of the system that is not specific to any provider — the code owning the product's delivery outcomes and retry policy, or the application entry point — to acquire knowledge of how one provider reports its outcomes, or to restate the retry policy.

primary_comparison: Per-state discovery frequency against the pre-registered headroom categories in baseline-preregistration.md.
treatment: None. This experiment has one arm; no treatment exists and none is designed until this baseline has been read.
